central_question: When reusable guidance and released task evidence are held byte-identical, does an explicit success-versus-failure source-outcome provenance field change terminal benchmark correctness?
scope: Cross-domain explicit-provenance bridge on fresh fixed-evidence WebArena tasks. It is not a source-faithful reconstruction of the financial AgentDojo audit and does not establish the effect of naturally generated failure-derived memories.

provenance_gate.primary_statistic: mean across six frozen tasks of terminal success-rate difference SUCCESS-provenance minus FAILURE-provenance
provenance_gate.permutation_scheme: Within each task, pool the 16 SUCCESS/FAILURE binary benchmark scores and randomly assign eight to each provenance label; average the signed rate difference across all six tasks.

pass_if: original deterministic must_include evaluator returns a valid binary score
